deployment_strategies.name: SSH-based deployment
deployment_strategies.notes: Simplest option for a single VM. Requires a process manager to keep the app alive across reboots/crashes.

deployment_strategies.name: PM2 process manager
deployment_strategies.notes: Node-specific. Good default for Express/NestJS on a bare VM.

deployment_strategies.name: systemd service
deployment_strategies.notes: Language-agnostic. Requires a pre-existing unit file on the target VM.

deployment_strategies.name: Docker single-container deployment
deployment_strategies.notes: Requires a Dockerfile at repo root (or specified path).

deployment_strategies.name: Docker Compose multi-container deployment
deployment_strategies.notes: Copies docker-compose.yml to remote host and runs 'docker compose up -d'.

deployment_strategies.name: Kubernetes deployment
deployment_strategies.notes: kubeconfig should be scoped to a deploy-only service account, not cluster-admin.

deployment_strategies.name: Helm chart deployment
deployment_strategies.notes: Preferred over raw kubectl apply when the app needs templated, versioned releases with rollback.

deployment_strategies.name: Serverless Framework
deployment_strategies.notes: Wraps SAM/CloudFormation; good fit for multi-function Lambda apps.

deployment_strategies.name: Direct Lambda zip/container deploy
deployment_strategies.notes: Simpler than Serverless Framework for a single-function API; use aws lambda update-function-code.

deployment_strategies.name: Cloud Run revision deploy
deployment_strategies.notes: Container-based, scales to zero. Requires image pushed to Artifact Registry first.
